question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Have you ever been teased for a picture that's been posted online?
Do you like to take photos?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Autumn, I know this is really upsetting, but try not to worry about everything all at once.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: How can I do that?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, first off, don't worry about the Art Showcase. We can reschedule.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Sniff... Sniff... Really?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, really. I'm the Social Chair.  If anyone can reschedule, it's me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's one of the perks of being in power.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Heh. I guess so.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And second, as for your photos... You can reprint them, can't you?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yes, I guess I can. But it'll take some time to print and mount them again.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's all right.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And of course, I'll swear to you that we'll find out who did this.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I found her in the photo lab one day after school, looking really shaken.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: She told me she'd found a note in her locker that said she was a 'creep' who should 'burn all her pictures'.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It really upset her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who sent the note?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I have my guesses.
Nick opens his laptop and navigates to his images folders. He opens a folder entitled 'Autumn Art' and sifts through them.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Autumn's entire exhibit focused around the juxtaposition between what is real and what is portrayed.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Meaning?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Meaning that she put candid pictures of the cheerleaders during practice next to their polished cheer photos in the yearbook.
Nick pulls up some pictures and shows them to $ZOE and Sam.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Here. These are the thumbnails of what Autumn's exhibit actually looked like.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let's see... There's Keith doing a cheer with the megaphone...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And another photo of him looking `super` depressed on the bleachers.
nodes.text_bbcode: And another photo of him looking [color=#3b78e2][i]super[/i][/color] depressed on the bleachers.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Check out Nicole's. All made up, cheering with her pom-poms in the yearbook... And then draped over some college guy on the sidelines during practice.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And then there's Maria doing an impressive toe touch with a wide smile...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Followed by a picture of her yelling at everyone else for dropping her after that last cheerleading routine.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Man, I did not know her face contorted that way...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah... These pictures aren't exactly `flattering.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... These pictures aren't exactly [color=#e23b3b][i]flattering.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE looks from the pictures to Nick.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You think one of them destroyed Autumn's photos?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey, it makes sense, doesn't it? That's probably why she didn't want to talk to you about it.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You don't cross the cheerleading team.
$ZOE gives him a look.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Not that all cheerleaders are bad! I'd cross you any day!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But do you really think Maria, Nicole, or Keith would destroy Autumn's photos over this?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Social wars have been waged for far less. And people are way more sensitive about bad photos ever since memes caught on.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's a meme?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's an internet thing. In this case, it's a funny or embarrassing photo with a caption in big letters on it. There are a ton on Erik Ericson. See?
Nick opens a website on his smart phone and shows it to $ZOE. $ZOE can see a picture of Erik Ericson's face with big white letters around him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: 'ENJOYS FRUITS... `AND` VEGETABLES!'
nodes.text_bbcode: 'ENJOYS FRUITS... [color=#3b78e2][i]AND[/i][/color] VEGETABLES!'

nodes.text: Nick scrolls down and shows them another one.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: 'WEARS GLASSES... BECAUSE HE HAS POOR VISION!'

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: These go on and on.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess I don't really get it.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: They're funny, they're catchy, and most of all, they're embarrassing. Just think what would happen if the `Dirty Dish` got one of Maria, Nicole, or Keith's photos?
nodes.text_bbcode: They're funny, they're catchy, and most of all, they're embarrassing. Just think what would happen if the [color=#e23b3b][i]Dirty Dish[/i][/color] got one of Maria, Nicole, or Keith's photos?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: They'd be a laughingstock.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But it's not like Autumn's making these memes.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But she would have put the photos out there, and someone probably wanted to stop her. My guess is that it's one of these cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maria, Nicole, and Keith. Would any of them really do something like this?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Face it... People aren't as nice as you, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know that not everyone is nice, but I'm serious. I couldn't see any of them trashing Autumn's art!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really? Maria's more vindictive than you think. Nicole has `no` morals whatsoever. Keith gets made fun of all the time for being a male cheerleader... He's gotta be holding a grudge!
nodes.text_bbcode: Really? Maria's more vindictive than you think. Nicole has [color=#3b78e2][i]no[/i][/color] morals whatsoever. Keith gets made fun of all the time for being a male cheerleader... He's gotta be holding a grudge!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I saw some people bugging Keith just the other day about that...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Poor Keith. No wonder he looks so depressed in that picture.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What I'm trying to say is... Any one's capable of anything if you push hard enough.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And if there's a chance that a bad picture is going to be floating around school, then you've got a lot to lose.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll try to talk to them at lunch. Thanks for the help, Nick.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sure. You can talk to me anytime. Let me know what you find out.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm going to try to get ahold of Autumn. She usually comes by to discuss her art projects. It's not like her to not show up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Good idea. Let us know if you find her. I hope she's okay...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do you know anything about that?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You know... Now that you mention it, I do remember Autumn was having a hard time earlier this week as well.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I don't think this is the first incident.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What happened before?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, who would? No one wants to be a whistleblower.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: A whistleblower?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You know, a snitch, a blabbermouth, a tattletale?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick, you are so weird some days...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Don't blame me for your poor vocabulary.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I `know` what a whistleblower is!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] what a whistleblower is!

nodes.text: She punches him playfully on the shoulder, nearly knocking him off his chair.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, `that` didn't give me any more information...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] didn't give me any more information...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But back to the destroyed art...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is there anything going on with Autumn? Anything at all that you remember?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Wait, I do remember something from earlier this week...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I will. Thanks, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But, wait, why are you guys here? Did you need something?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Someone vandalized Autumn's art project!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's horrible.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We're trying to figure out who did it. Do you know anyone who'd have something against her?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry, no one jumps out at me. But my social life's pretty much been basketball. At least until the game.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But you know, if you can find someone who really knows Autumn, I'm sure you'll find who did it.
Ben picks up a basketball and starts shooting around as $ZOE and Sam head out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ben's right. If we're going to figure this out, we need to get inside her head. We need to think like a pretentious artist...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I know just the pretentious artist to ask...
$ZOE and Sam find Nick in the room where the journalism club meets. He's looking over pictures in his camera's viewfinder.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey, Sam. I was just thinking about you.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Er, about what you said. The other day. When we were hanging out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ooh, you guys were hanging out? I didn't know about `this.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ooh, you guys were hanging out? I didn't know about [color=#3b78e2][i]this.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Stop it, cuz. I know where you're going with this. Do `not` embarrass me.
nodes.text_bbcode: Stop it, cuz. I know where you're going with this. Do [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] embarrass me.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of `course` not...
nodes.text_bbcode: Of [color=#3b78e2][i]course[/i][/color] not...

nodes.text: She winks at Sam, who groans.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Actually, all we did was watch a frightening zombie movie!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Frightening? Please. The only thing scary about it was that someone actually thought it was worth making.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: So what brings you to my neck of the woods? Don't you guys have class?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, in like ten minutes. But we want some information from you.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Intriguing. I'm betting you probably don't want to know the complex relationship between aperture and depth of field...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually, it's about Autumn. All three of the photos that Autumn put up for the showcase have been defaced.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What? When did this happen?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yesterday.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Oh no... Poor Autumn. She's been working hard on pulling together the right photos for that exhibit.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, she did. I tried to talk to her yesterday about who might have done it, but she just ran away. I was hoping you could help.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: When I talked to her, Autumn said that...

options.label: She didn't want to go to the principal.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I bake a lot of cupcakes! The cuter the better. It cheers me up, and you can't be stressed when you smile.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks, $ZOE, but I'm not really a baker.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Plus, I don't think eating cupcakes before a basketball game will help me that much. Coach is always making us run. All that sugar might make me sick.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I see your point. Well, whenever I'm stressed, it also helps to talk Sam or my aunt.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Having friends around is important.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just to be able to talk to someone and know they're there makes a big difference.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You helped me so much with the Halloween Dance and party-planning. If you need anything from me, just let me know!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Everything I've done up until now has been successful because I've had a lot of support.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I mean, you helped me with the house party and the Halloween Dance. And I couldn't have done anything without Sam helping me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not that you should rely on someone else all the time, but sometimes support is the best thing.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, you're right. How'd you figure that one out?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's just something I've learned.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: At least Wilson High isn't as far away from home as that last school. You'll have all the support you need in the stands.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And you know, I definitely owe you a favor, so if you need anything from me, just let me know!
$ZOE blanks out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, what's the question again?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How do you deal with stress?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe someone's trying to get revenge on Autumn.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You mean like Autumn pissed someone off?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah. I don't know who though.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Have you asked her?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think she's going to tell me anything.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You should have seen her, Sam. She was shaking. She took off when I tried to ask about it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I texted her last night a bunch. She hasn't replied yet.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Have you tried calling her?
$ZOE finds Autumn's number and calls. The phone rings, but there's no answer.
She tries again.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No answer. We're on our own for now.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Great. What now?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I've been out of touch with what's happening lately at the Center Table.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But Ben might know something! Let's check with him!
$ZOE and Sam find Ben shooting baskets in the empty gymnasium.
He stands at the three-point line and takes a shot. It bounces off the rim.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...Well, that sucked.
They walk up to him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Ben...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's wrong? Bad morning?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Bad week. The basketball game against Wilson is coming up really soon. There's a lot of pressure to win.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And even more pressure on `me` to help the team win.
nodes.text_bbcode: And even more pressure on [color=#e23b3b][i]me[/i][/color] to help the team win.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If I can't lead the team to victory, then not only do we lose our chance at Sectionals, but... I think I'll be back to square zero with Emily's dad.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yikes, that's tough.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Being a leader's never easy, is it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: As Social Chair, I feel a lot more responsible now. There's pressure to not let people down.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, funny how that works.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How do you deal with it? It's a lot of stress.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: For me, it's a good work out. What about you, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I find that I deal with it better when I have...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Like someone had something against her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The only damage that was done was to her art. It's not like people pushed the garbage cans over, or messed with the instruments.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This doesn't feel like it was done for kicks.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I agree. Whoever did this was angry at Autumn.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But what were they angry about?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I have no idea.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Great... So we're looking for someone cruel.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Cheerleaders can be pretty cruel... But then again so can outcasts... And I've heard the nerds can be pretty cruel to each other...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess that doesn't really narrow anything down.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No... And Besides, I'm thinking this was personal.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whoever did this didn't trash the whole room. They `just` targeted Autumn.
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoever did this didn't trash the whole room. They [color=#3b78e2][i]just[/i][/color] targeted Autumn.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I don't know where to start. Autumn doesn't want me to talk to the principal.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: There are other ways to find things out than asking the principal. In fact, I'm sure you can do a better job anyway.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All right.
Taylor leans across the table, glowering...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Find the scumbag who did this. Do `not` let this injustice stand!
nodes.text_bbcode: Find the scumbag who did this. Do [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] let this injustice stand!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, ma'am!
$ZOE and Sam leave the office.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: My job is `so` cool some days.
nodes.text_bbcode: My job is [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] cool some days.

nodes.text: $ZOE and Sam leave Taylor's office.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Geez, Taylor makes an even worse leader than I remember. She's so bossy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She's always been bossy... But that doesn't make her a bad leader.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And she's right about the Autumn thing. We shouldn't have a showcase if we don't know why all of Autumn's art pieces were destroyed.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So who do you think painted over Autumn's photos?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know... But I'm guessing they did it...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And she's so sad right now, Taylor. This totally destroyed her.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's cute that you're championing for her, $ZOE. Really it is.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But that's still not a good excuse.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You don't think she'll be hurt even more when it happens again?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We need to figure out what happened. And `then` I'll consider putting it back on.
nodes.text_bbcode: We need to figure out what happened. And [color=#3b78e2][i]then[/i][/color] I'll consider putting it back on.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If we don't reschedule, whoever did this will think they can get away with it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It'll be worse! We can't let people like that win.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Interesting...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So you'll reschedule?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm on your side, $ZOE. I still think finding out who's behind this is the most important thing.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Otherwise, it's just going to keep happening over and over again.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Tell you what. If you figure out what happened, we'll put the Art Showcase back on.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Autumn, think about it this way...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is only a `minor` disaster.
nodes.text_bbcode: This is only a [color=#3b78e2][i]minor[/i][/color] disaster.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: A `minor` disaster?!
nodes.text_bbcode: A [color=#3b78e2][i]minor[/i][/color] disaster?!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Is that supposed to make me feel better? It's `minor` the way a `hurricane` is a `wind tunnel.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Is that supposed to make me feel better? It's [color=#3b78e2][i]minor[/i][/color] the way a [color=#3b78e2][i]hurricane[/i][/color] is a [color=#3b78e2][i]wind tunnel.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: This is a `catastrophe!`
nodes.text_bbcode: This is a [color=#3b78e2][i]catastrophe![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, so it's a problem. But we can figure this out. The art show's in a couple days...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: And there's no way I can reprint all my photos, mount them, and display them by then!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, wait... I can fix it. We'll reschedule the gallery. It'll be fine, I promise.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I also promise you that we'll find out who did this.
$ZOE pulls together the last of her reserves and climbs to the top.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes!
She looks around and sees Maria running away.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maria! Stop!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: She `deserved` it!
nodes.text_bbcode: She [color=#3b78e2][i]deserved[/i][/color] it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So you really did do it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But why? Your picture wasn't even in the Art Showcase...

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: That's the whole point!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? You `wanted` your picture to be up there?!
nodes.text_bbcode: What? You [color=#3b78e2][i]wanted[/i][/color] your picture to be up there?!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But why? Maria thought it was super embarrassing!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Why? `Why?!` It figures that someone like you wouldn't understand.
nodes.text_bbcode: Why? [color=#3b78e2][i]Why?![/i][/color] It figures that someone like you wouldn't understand.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: You're Social Chair! You're `somebody` at this school!
nodes.text_bbcode: You're Social Chair! You're [color=#3b78e2][i]somebody[/i][/color] at this school!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: But me? I'm a freshman. No one knows who I am. I thought cheerleading would be my ticket up.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: But no one really pays attention to me! It's all on Nicole, or Maria, or Amanda, or `you!`
nodes.text_bbcode: But no one really pays attention to me! It's all on Nicole, or Maria, or Amanda, or [color=#3b78e2][i]you![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: And when that hipster loser left `my` pictures out of her stupid art show, it was the last straw!
nodes.text_bbcode: And when that hipster loser left [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] pictures out of her stupid art show, it was the last straw!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So you ruined Autumn's painting because she `didn't` include you? That's insane!
nodes.text_bbcode: So you ruined Autumn's painting because she [color=#3b78e2][i]didn't[/i][/color] include you? That's insane!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: I don't really care what you think. And you can't make me regret what I did! `She` should be apologizing to `me.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't really care what you think. And you can't make me regret what I did! [color=#3b78e2][i]She[/i][/color] should be apologizing to [color=#3b78e2][i]me.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, that's not how it `works.` You can't treat someone else like that. And I'm turning you in.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, that's not how it [color=#3b78e2][i]works.[/i][/color] You can't treat someone else like that. And I'm turning you in.

nodes.text: Before Lindsay can react, $ZOE runs off, heading straight for school and Taylor's office.
You have reached the end of `Season 4, Episode 2, Showcase Sabotage, Part 1!`

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You said 'red paint.'

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Yeah? So what?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I never said the paint was `red.` And no one except me and Autumn saw the ruined photos.
nodes.text_bbcode: I never said the paint was [color=#3b78e2][i]red.[/i][/color] And no one except me and Autumn saw the ruined photos.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Uh...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Lindsay, were you the one who destroyed Autumn's photos?

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Yeah? So what? That's what she is, isn't she?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, she's not... She's a nice person, and she's doing great things.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: All right, fine. Whatever. Agree to disagree.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'd better go. I need to figure things out.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Good luck finding the culprit, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sure.
As Lindsay walks away, $ZOE sighs.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do I do now?
The next day, $ZOE walks into Taylor's office.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Taylor. I honestly don't know who vandalized Autumn's art. And I'm all out of suspects.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's unfortunate. If we don't know who did, I don't think it's a good idea to put the art show back on. I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah. Me too.
$ZOE turns away from Taylor's desk, looking mournfully at the ground.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Autumn won't get her Showcase, and I'll never know what really happened...
And even though $ZOE tells herself there's nothing more to be done...
$ZOE blanks.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You... You called Autumn a 'loser'.
Maria at last comes to a stop, breathing hard and resting heavily against a tree.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: All... Huff... Right. Huff... You win.
Maria takes a long drink from the water bottle in her hand.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You... Huff... Are very... Huff... Fast.
They fall silent. For a moment, the only sounds are the birds in the trees and the two girls taking in deep gulps of air.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So, why'd you run away?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Like I said, I don't really want to talk about that `hipster.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Like I said, I don't really want to talk about that [color=#3b78e2][i]hipster.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe not, but we're going to.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You've really hurt her.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Oh yeah? What about what she's doing to me? If those pictures go up, then `everyone` is going to `make fun of me!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh yeah? What about what she's doing to me? If those pictures go up, then [color=#3b78e2][i]everyone[/i][/color] is going to [color=#3b78e2][i]make fun of me![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I work really hard to be me, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I wake up at five to do my hair and makeup, I save all my money to get the best clothes, and I work out all the time! I look good!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: But Autumn's photo shows me as this horrible, angry control freak! That's not how I am. It's not how I want to be seen.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Don't you get it? You should be on my side!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maria, I get why you're upset, but that doesn't mean you can destroy Autumn's work...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Destroy her work? All I did was send her a note!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: All I wanted was for her to take my picture down. I wouldn't `destroy it.`
nodes.text_bbcode: All I wanted was for her to take my picture down. I wouldn't [color=#3b78e2][i]destroy it.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You didn't paint over all of her pictures?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: No! What are you talking about? I'm `mad`, not crazy!
nodes.text_bbcode: No! What are you talking about? I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]mad[/i][/color], not crazy!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Geez, $ZOE... Who do you think I am?
Maria steps back, turns away, and runs down the trail, disappearing.
$ZOE stares after her, unsure what to do next.
$ZOE slowly finds her way back down into the park. She runs into Lindsay by the park's entrance.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: How'd it go? Did you catch up with her?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: So what was that all about?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The photos Autumn was using for the Art Showcase were vandalized. Someone painted over all of them.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Ugh. Well, they weren't very good anyway.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: The photos were kind of crap. Just because you can make photos black-and-white doesn't mean you're a real artist. Isn't that a little lame?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought they looked pretty good...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But that doesn't matter now. I didn't figure out who painted over them. I thought it must have been one of the cheerleaders since that's what all the photos were of.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But after talking to all of them, I'm pretty sure they're innocent... I'm all out of ideas.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Sorry. Sounds like you're never going to find who splattered red paint on that loser's photos...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, I--

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait, that word you just said...
$ZOE attempts to climb up, but her grip slips on the rocks, and she falls hard to the ground!
She stands up, rubbing her now bruised backside.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owww...
Above her, Maria's made it to the top and has run away.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess I'll have to talk to her tomorrow...
The next day, $ZOE tries to talk to Maria...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And then, I totally told Marcus Jones that he wasn't as much of a model as he pretended to be.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You didn't!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: It's nice that you can see right through him. Most girls only notice his looks.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't confront her now. I don't want the others to see...
And at lunch...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey Maria! I want to talk to you.
Maria takes a quick look at $ZOE and sits down in between Nicole, Lindsay, and Cameron.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...Or not.
A few days later, $ZOE still hasn't had a chance to talk to Maria. She meets Taylor in her office.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So do you know who vandalized Autumn's paintings?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I `think` it's Maria... But I'm not sure.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]think[/i][/color] it's Maria... But I'm not sure.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $ZOE, that's not good enough. I didn't want you to find who you `think` it is.
nodes.text_bbcode: $ZOE, that's not good enough. I didn't want you to find who you [color=#3b78e2][i]think[/i][/color] it is.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I wanted you to figure out what happened!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know, but I can't reach her. She's impossible to get to!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm sorry, $ZOE, but this isn't going to work out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But--

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Without knowing who destroyed Autumn's photos, I don't think it's a good idea to put the art show back on. I'm sorry.
$ZOE turns away from Taylor's desk, looking mournfully at the ground.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Autumn won't get her Showcase, and I'll never know what really happened...
And even though $ZOE tells herself there's nothing to be done...
She knows she's failed.

nodes.text: $ZOE skids to a hard stop.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What am I doing?!
$ZOE pushes her body into motion again, but she's considerably slower.
Maria gets further ahead...
She propels herself forward, pumping her feet and arms faster and faster...
The distance between her and Maria shortens...
$ZOE runs out into the opening surrounding the lake.
Ahead, Maria runs at full-steam, little clouds of dust in her path. $ZOE...
$ZOE takes a sharp left, going the exact opposite direction of Maria!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no! Wrong way!
She backtracks to where Maria left the path.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm going to lose her!
$ZOE pumps her legs faster. She doesn't think as she plunges deeper into the thicket.
Branches scrape at her face and arms.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ow! Ow! Ow!
She fights her way forward until...
$ZOE makes the sharp turn right after her, running straight into the trees.
Just ahead of her, $ZOE can barely make out Maria's green shirt through the foliage as they plunge deeper into the thicket.
She dodges sticks in the ground and low branches until finally...
$ZOE doesn't turn! Instead, she continues forward on the path, missing Maria!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She's definitely hiding something...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maria, I need to ask you something about Autumn's art. The photos were--
But Maria cuts her off.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I don't know anything!
Maria takes off. $ZOE stands stunned for a second before sprinting after them!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Uh... Guys! Wait!
$ZOE and Maria leave Lindsay behind.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maria, wait!
Maria glances over her shoulder, then takes a sharp right turn off the path!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Autumn?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, she had some photos--

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I don't want to talk about Autumn.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But--

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Who cares about that loser anyway?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whoa, that's a little harsh.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I'm sorry. I can be a little `grumpy` if I don't start my run on time.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm sorry. I can be a little [color=#3b78e2][i]grumpy[/i][/color] if I don't start my run on time.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, it'll only take a second. I have a follow-up question.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Forget it, $ZOE. I need to go on `now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Forget it, $ZOE. I need to go on [color=#3b78e2][i]now.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Uh... Which one?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The one for the Art Showcase.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Sure. What about it?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I hope it's not about the face I'm making. Because I wasn't shouting, I was mid-sneeze, I swear!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: At least she's open to talking...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Would you say that photo made you mad?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Sure it did! I hate it when people take bad pictures of me. Why?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, sometimes when people get mad, they take it out on someone else...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And that someone might be Autumn.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I'm sorry. I don't have anything to say about her. Now, I have to run.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The, uh...

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: What do you want, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: To talk about Autumn.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're not embarrassed by it?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Please. I barely even remember that photo.
The teacher calls Nicole up to bat.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: But, hey... If you do find a picture of me holding a comic book, `please` don't tell anyone about it.
nodes.text_bbcode: But, hey... If you do find a picture of me holding a comic book, [color=#3b78e2][i]please[/i][/color] don't tell anyone about it.

nodes.text: She picks up a bat and stares down the pitcher.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess it's not Nicole after all...
After school, $ZOE finds Maria in a nearby park, dressed for a run and stretching with Lindsay. $ZOE approaches them.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, guys!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE! What's up? You've been so busy lately, that we never see you outside practice anymore...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know... I didn't know how busy Social Chair would be...

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: We're excited to see what event you're putting on for the cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Er, I haven't quite planned--

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah! We heard about the Art Showcase. If you're planning something amazing for those artist weirdos, then you've got to have something for us, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Er, sure! Nothing definite yet, but I'll look into it.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: So what are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Looking for you. I wanted to talk to you about...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ohmygosh, you've `seen` the photo?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ohmygosh, you've [color=#3b78e2][i]seen[/i][/color] the photo?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It was going to be on display.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Oh no... That photo cannot be shown! That would be `so` embarrassing!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh no... That photo cannot be shown! That would be [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] embarrassing!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I'm going to `strangle` that artist for letting it get out!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm going to [color=#3b78e2][i]strangle[/i][/color] that artist for letting it get out!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think you should do that to Autumn!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Autumn? What does she have to do with anything?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait... What photo are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: ...What photo are `you` talking about?
nodes.text_bbcode: ...What photo are [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] talking about?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The one that Autumn took? The one of you all over that older guy?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Oh, `that` picture! Who cares about that picture?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] picture! Who cares about that picture?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: But there's this `other` one that I took with my phone and texted to this artist guy at the community college...
nodes.text_bbcode: But there's this [color=#3b78e2][i]other[/i][/color] one that I took with my phone and texted to this artist guy at the community college...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I don't want anyone to see that one.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait, so about Autumn's picture...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ooh... Which one? Daniel? Lance?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... No. I'm talking about an older guy.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Jeremy? Liam?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The guy in the photo that Autumn took?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Oh! Jared! I love that guy! He's, like, `so` hot. When Autumn took that picture, I was `so` happy.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh! Jared! I love that guy! He's, like, [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] hot. When Autumn took that picture, I was [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] happy.

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Really? Keith said you were really angry about it yesterday.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Uh, yeah... I was hanging out with a super hot college guy. But she didn't even get his face in it!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: How am I going to show Maria that he was into me without a good shot of his face?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ugh, that was so disappointing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait, so...
Keith stares at her...
Then bursts out laughing.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: `Harassed?` That's going a little far, isn't it?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Harassed?[/i][/color] That's going a little far, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If people are hurting your feelings, Keith, it's not okay.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Please. If I had a dollar for every time someone's made fun of me for being on the cheerleading squad, then I'd have `two` smartphones by now.
nodes.text_bbcode: Please. If I had a dollar for every time someone's made fun of me for being on the cheerleading squad, then I'd have [color=#e23b3b][i]two[/i][/color] smartphones by now.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I like being on the squad.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Besides, I have a way of dealing with people that make fun of me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's that?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I just tell them that I hang out with the hottest girls in school. How's a guy supposed to make fun of you for that?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So you're not upset about Autumn taking a picture of you looking depressed?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: What? No! Why would I care about that?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because it might be embarrassing?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: No way. I saw the photo. It's my best side, so I'm not complaining.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He's completely serious... He's not upset about it at all.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Although if you're asking about Autumn's photos, I heard that Maria and Nicole aren't happy about theirs. They were ranting about it just yesterday.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Really?
She looks over to where they're happily chatting.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: ...Cameron is `so` ripped. Let's just say I don't mind seeing him shirtless every day.
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Cameron is [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] ripped. Let's just say I don't mind seeing him shirtless every day.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You are `so` lucky. Cameron is `so` hot... I wish I got to be close to him all the time.
nodes.text_bbcode: You are [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] lucky. Cameron is [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] hot... I wish I got to be close to him all the time.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: That's what you say about every jock.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But they seem so happy.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Yeah... `Right now.` Not when they found out their photos would be in a public showcase. They were `mad.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... [color=#e23b3b][i]Right now.[/i][/color] Not when they found out their photos would be in a public showcase. They were [color=#e23b3b][i]mad.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Mad enough to try to stop Autumn from showing them?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Well... People can get mad enough to do just about anything, right?
$ZOE watches Maria and Nicole gather their trays and head off to class, talking conspiratorially.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... I guess they can.
In P.E., the girls play softball. $ZOE stands next to Nicole as they wait for their turn to bat.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ugh, this is so stupid.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What is?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Being here! In class!
They inch closer to the front of the line.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Come on... The least they could do is let the guys play football, so there'd be something `interesting` to look at.
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on... The least they could do is let the guys play football, so there'd be something [color=#3b78e2][i]interesting[/i][/color] to look at.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Seeing `Owen` play would cheer me right up!
nodes.text_bbcode: Seeing [color=#3b78e2][i]Owen[/i][/color] play would cheer me right up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... Listen, Nicole, I want to talk to you...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Sure. About what?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Yeah, exactly.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: It's hard being in a long distance relationship...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I haven't been in one myself, but trust me, I can sympathize.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard and I almost did one, and even `thinking` about it seemed impossible.
nodes.text_bbcode: Howard and I almost did one, and even [color=#3b78e2][i]thinking[/i][/color] about it seemed impossible.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: It's good to talk to someone who understands a little of what I'm going through then.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm happy to listen.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I may take you up on that. But maybe not right now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But other than that... Are things okay with you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You haven't been teased lately, have you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I heard that you were harassed about being on the cheerleading team yesterday...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: You really think I get this twisted up inside because of homework?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um, some people do?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Well, clearly some people take their classwork way to seriously.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So it's not academics then.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is it... Maybe... Related to some of the gossip that's been flying around the halls?
Keith looks out in the distance and frowns.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I heard that you were harassed about being on the cheerleading team yesterday...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Cheerleading?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know... Sometimes people have off days. They can't jump or cheer...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: You really think I get this twisted up because I can't yell loudly enough?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well... Maybe not when you put it like that.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: It's definitely not cheerleading.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I see that.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is it... Maybe... Related to some of the gossip that's been flying around the halls?
Keith looks out in the distance and frowns.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I heard that you were harassed about being on the cheerleading team yesterday...
At lunch, $ZOE finds the cheerleaders at the Center Table. Maria and Nicole are surrounded, so $ZOE sits next to Keith at the edge.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hey, cheerleaders! I just wanted to give a shout out to the new members of our team... Lindsay and Shannon!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It's the first day they're sitting with us!
To her right, a pretty blonde girl and a quiet redhead wave and smile sheepishly.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I `love` new people! Hi, I'm Amanda!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] new people! Hi, I'm Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Amanda, we're on the swim team together. I used to be friends with Dominique?

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: And we met at tryouts. We've hung out literally hundreds of times.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: ...Taylor?!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Uh... Sure.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Woo hoo! More girls!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah, more girls to stand on in the pyramid!
On the other side of the Center Table, $ZOE turns to Keith.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So Keith, how are you?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Good.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, I saw the photo that Autumn took of your for her Art Showcase...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Ugh, that picture? It's not my greatest.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think you looked terrible. But you did look incredibly sad.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I've been better.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh? What's up?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Eh. It's pretty obvious.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It is?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Yeah... I can't eat, I can't think, and I can't even get up early enough in the morning to gel my hair...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know what's going on. This is about...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll go to the principal right now, and...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: No! Please don't!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Going to the principal will just make everything worse. I'll be branded a 'rat'!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: And I can't handle seeing my art destroyed like this again!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But the principal can actually `do` something about this.
nodes.text_bbcode: But the principal can actually [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] something about this.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yeah, but don't you see that it'll make my life harder than it already is?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: This is the `second` bad thing that's happened this week. I don't think I can take it anymore...
nodes.text_bbcode: This is the [color=#3b78e2][i]second[/i][/color] bad thing that's happened this week. I don't think I can take it anymore...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Nothing. Never mind. I'll get all my photos up again.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Just don't tell the principal. Please, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Autumn, it'll be worse if you don't tell anyone. You have to do `something.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Autumn, it'll be worse if you don't tell anyone. You have to do [color=#3b78e2][i]something.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: After school, $ZOE finds Maria in a nearby park, dressed for a run and stretching with Lindsay. $ZOE approaches them.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, guys!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE! What's up? You've been so busy lately, that we never see you outside practice anymore...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know... I didn't know how busy Social Chair would be...

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: We're excited to see what event you're putting on for the cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Er, I haven't quite planned--

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah! We heard about the Art Showcase. If you're planning something amazing for those artist weirdos, then you've got to have something for us, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Er, sure! Nothing definite yet, but I'll look into it.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: So what are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Looking for you. I wanted to talk to you about...
$ZOE slowly finds her way back down into the park. She runs into Lindsay by the park's entrance.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: How'd it go? Did you catch up with her?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: So what was that all about?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The photos Autumn was using for the Art Showcase were vandalized. Someone painted over all of them.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Ugh. Well, they weren't very good anyway.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: The photos were kind of crap. Just because you can make photos black-and-white doesn't mean you're a real artist. Isn't that a little lame?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought they looked pretty good...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But that doesn't matter now. I didn't figure out who painted over them. I thought it must have been one of the cheerleaders since that's what all the photos were of.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But after talking to all of them, I'm pretty sure they're innocent... I'm all out of ideas.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Sorry. Sounds like you're never going to find who splattered red paint on that loser's photos...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, I--

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait, that word you just said...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hey, cheerleaders! I just wanted to give a shout out to the new members of our team... Lindsay and Shannon!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It's the first day they're sitting with us!

nodes.text: And we met at tryouts. We've hung out literally hundreds of times.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: ...Taylor?!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Uh... Sure.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Woo hoo! More girls!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah, more girls to stand on in the pyramid!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So Keith, how are you?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Good.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, I saw the photo that Autumn took of your for her Art Showcase...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Ugh, that picture? It's not my greatest.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think you looked terrible. But you did look incredibly sad.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I've been better.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh? What's up?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Eh. It's pretty obvious.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It is?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Yeah... I can't eat, I can't think, and I can't even get up early enough in the morning to gel my hair...
